purpose: Concise current classification of superseded architectures. This is a boundary manifest, not deletion authority.

entries.replacement: native ReelOS source, preparation, and retention services
entries.releaseBoundary: Must not appear in active installers, settings, consumer copy, or release artifacts.
Do not install or manage a Jellyfin server.

entries.replacement: none; this is the deliberately retained compatibility boundary
entries.releaseBoundary: Must delegate source, profile, and child-safety authority to native ReelOS.

entries.replacement: local capability runtime plus deterministic fallbacks
entries.releaseBoundary: Must not be required by the native runtime or presented as the neural spine.

entries.replacement: local learning and authorized within-Home matching; all cross-home learning exports retired
entries.releaseBoundary: Routes are retired and implementations cannot enter the native package.

entries.replacement: shared coordinator, guarded local runtime, and resource governor
entries.releaseBoundary: May remain only for classified migration tests until explicit retirement evidence permits deletion.

entries.replacement: device-native Windows, Linux, Android phone/tablet, and Android TV renderers over the shared ReelOS core, state, neural, design-token, and behavior contracts
entries.releaseBoundary: Browser-rendered surfaces may remain only as development visual references, migration fixtures, automated test harnesses, and the temporary iOS browser/PWA fallback. They cannot enter Windows, Linux, Android, or Android TV consumer release packages or count as native-platform evidence.
